historical_line: Wolfgang Doeblin's sealed Kolmogorov manuscript: drift removal, variance clock, and interrupted ordered-drift comparison
scoped_theorem: For one-dimensional SDEs with a common smooth positive diffusion, if Lamperti-coordinate drifts are beta_j(y)=g(y)+o_j with ordered offsets and y+h*g(y) nondecreasing, shared-noise transformed Euler preserves pathwise order at every step.
retained: Doeblin drift-removal and quadratic-variation-clock mechanism as historical lineage
step-size-certified pathwise comparison in transformed coordinates
raw Euler finite-step order violation as an executable failure boundary
not_solved: discontinuous or vanishing diffusion and the resulting local-time correction
order preservation when the transformed Euler base map is not monotone
novelty beyond active Lamperti and order-preserving numerical-scheme literatures
collision: Strong: Dambis-Dubins-Schwarz subsumes the continuous martingale clock, modern SDE comparison theory subsumes the continuous ordered-drift result, and order-preserving/Lamperti numerical schemes are active literatures.
